Keep everything. Finish the interface, the feedback and check the template. Add this section to game_spec.json and use it for every string:
{"text":{"controlsKeyboard":"Left/Right: aim - Hold Space: power, release: launch","controlsTouch":"Drag back and release to launch","controlsTouchImpulse":"Touch to aim, hold for power, release to launch","lose":"Out of shots","win":"All levels cleared!","levelClear":"Level clear!","level":"Level","shots":"Shots","next":"Next level"}}

HUD (anchored to visible screen edges + safe margin, strings rebuilt only on change)
- Top-left: score (large), "Level 2/5" below (text.level).
- Top-center: remaining shots as small player-colored circles, used shots as empty line-colored rings.
- Top-right: pause button.
- While charging: power bar next to the launcher (16x160, player fill, pickup color above 0.9), aim line, preview dots.

SCREENS
- Title: attract mode showing level 1 with an automatic demo shot every 3 s, game title, best score, hints: text.controlsKeyboard plus text.controlsTouch (slingshot) or text.controlsTouchImpulse (tapImpulse), highlight the last input type used, text.tapToStart.
- LEVEL_CLEAR: text.levelClear, shots bonus, button text.next.
- Result: text.lose or text.win, score, best with "New best!", levels cleared, buttons Play again and Menu.

FEEDBACK (style.feedback)
- Charging: ball squashes toward the pull direction, up to 15%.
- Launch: short stretch 0.1 s.
- Bounce: squash on contact + 3 particles in the obstacle color.
- Target break: burst in the target color + "+N" popup.
- Level clear: remaining shot icons pop one by one into "+bonus" popups.

DEBUG OVERLAY (debug.showFps)
FPS, phase, ball speed, substeps used this frame, shots left.

ACCEPTANCE CHECK (fix anything that fails, then report)
1. Slingshot: drag back anywhere, aim line + power bar + preview, release launches; a tiny drag cancels without using a shot.
2. tapImpulse: angle follows the pointer, meter oscillates while held, release launches.
3. Keyboard in both modes: arrows aim, Space hold/release launches with the same physics.
4. Editing gravity, restitution or friction in game_spec.json changes the flight as expected.
5. maxLaunchSpeed 2500 with restitution 1: no tunneling; bouncer adds energy, sticky kills it.
6. One shot can break several targets; slow touches bounce off.
7. Shots counter, rest detection and bonus (remaining shots * shotBonus) are correct.
8. 5 levels in order with LEVEL_CLEAR between them, win after level 5, lose when out of shots.
9. Score shown = value sent with sendScore = best saved.
10. Layout correct at 9:32, 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 32:9; full run with keyboard only, mouse only and touch only.
11. No value hard-coded outside game_spec.json, no console errors, no network requests.
List the game_spec.json keys you added in this step, if any.
